source_description_html:
Upgrade the look and performance of your S1000RR with our LED Headlight set. Featuring bright white lights, this headlight will not only enhance the appearance of your bike but also provide improved visibility on the road. Say goodbye to dull, outdated headlights and ride in style with our LED upgrade!  


"Plug & Play" LED headlight set, installs exactly like the OEM BMW halogen headlights. Installing these headlights will NOT cause your computer to throw any error codes / warning triangle, it is Canbus compatible.

Headlight: Plug & Play, direct replacement

LED: Cree

Voltage: 12v 

Power - LEFT: DRL 6w / Low Beam 33w

Power - RIGHT: DRL 5w / High Beam 26w

Certification: E9 

Warranty: 2 year
